item.title: Blanche's path to confirmation appears clear after winning key Republican's support
item.description: A key Republican senator, Bill Cassidy of Louisiana, said he would back Todd Blanche's nomination as attorney general, smoothing the path for his ultimate confirmation by the Senate.

item.title: Employers unexpectedly cut 23,000 jobs in a sign of a wilting labor market
item.description: U.S. employers cut 23,000 jobs in July, and job gains for the two previous months were weaker than initially reported, according to a report Friday from the Labor Department.
item.content:encoded:

item.description: Over 1 million people a year die from diarrheal disease. Nearly half are kids under age 5. A new vaccine in trials offers great hope.

item.title: Everyone's talking about hormone therapy for menopause. Should I be on it?
item.description: For years, doctors advised against hormone therapy for women in the menopausal transition. Now everyone's talking about how great it is. Is it really a wonder drug that women should all be on?
